title: AscendraSharedEventEnvelopeV1
description: PROPOSED SHARED CONTRACT (v1) — Versioned event envelope between NEON and CARBON. Requires coordination before breaking changes.

event_id.description: Globally unique immutable identifier for this event instance.

idempotency_key.description: Optional logical deduplication key. Defaults to event_id when omitted.

occurred_at.description: Authoritative ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the domain event occurred.

correlation_id.description: Trace correlation identifier propagating across world simulation and persistence.
